# Rippling MCP connector

Rippling HR platform: workers and users, departments, teams, work locations, levels, titles, employment types, custom fields, compensation, leave types, balances and requests, supergroups and time entries. The AnythingMCP connector gives Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Cursor and Gemini 42 MCP tools for Rippling: 29 read and 13 can change data.

[![Open Rippling in AnythingMCP Cloud](https://img.shields.io/badge/Open%20in-AnythingMCP%20Cloud-1f6feb?style=for-the-badge)](https://cloud.anythingmcp.com/login?mode=register&redirect=%2Fconnectors%2Fstore%3Finstall%3Drippling&utm_source=github&utm_medium=catalog&utm_campaign=rippling)

**Category:** [HR](../hr.md) · **Tools:** 42 · **Setup guide:** [anythingmcp.com](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/rippling-to-mcp) · [Deutsch](https://anythingmcp.com/de/guides/rippling-to-mcp) · [Italiano](https://anythingmcp.com/it/guides/rippling-to-mcp) · [Español](https://anythingmcp.com/es/guides/rippling-to-mcp) · [日本語](https://anythingmcp.com/ja/guides/rippling-to-mcp) · [Русский](https://anythingmcp.com/ru/guides/rippling-to-mcp) · [中文](https://anythingmcp.com/zh/guides/rippling-to-mcp)

## Start without code

No installation and no terminal: AnythingMCP Cloud runs the Rippling connector for you, operated by helpcode.ai in Frankfurt, Germany.

1. **Click the button above** and create an account or sign in. The Rippling connector opens, ready to install.
2. **Paste the API key or token from your Rippling account.** Every click is in the [step-by-step guide](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/rippling-to-mcp).
3. **Click Install.** AnythingMCP shows the address of your MCP server.
4. **Add that address to your assistant:** [Claude](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-rippling-to-claude) · [ChatGPT](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-rippling-to-chatgpt) · [Microsoft Copilot](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-rippling-to-copilot) · [Cursor](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-rippling-to-cursor) · [Gemini CLI](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-rippling-to-gemini) · [Meta Muse](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-rippling-to-muse).
5. **Ask your first question**, for example: *Find worker record for maria.ortega@solera-consulting.es — I need title, start date, manager and location.*

Prefer help with the setup? [Talk to us](https://anythingmcp.com/contact).

## How it works

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  client["Claude · ChatGPT · Copilot · Cursor"]
  amcp["AnythingMCP<br/>roles · audit log · encrypted credentials"]
  api["Rippling API<br/>rest.ripplingapis.com"]
  client -- "MCP, OAuth or API key" --> amcp
  amcp -- "HTTPS, a bearer token" --> api
```

- **The AI client** speaks MCP (Streamable HTTP) to AnythingMCP and only sees tool names, descriptions and results. It never gets the Rippling credentials.
- **AnythingMCP** checks the client's role, builds the call from the tool definition, adds the credentials (a bearer token), calls Rippling, logs the call and returns the result.
- **Rippling** sees an ordinary API client with the rights of the account the credentials belong to.

## Tool reference

Every parameter as the AI client sees it in `tools/list`. Source: [`packages/backend/src/adapters/intl/rippling.json`](../../../packages/backend/src/adapters/intl/rippling.json).

### `rippling_list_companies`

List the Rippling company the token belongs to (name, legal name, primary email, address, legal entities when expanded). The install check: it only needs the companies.read scope.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /companies/`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `expand` | string | no | Comma-separated related objects to embed instead of only their id (two levels at most, ten fields at most), e.g. "legal_entities". Expandable: legal_entities, parent_legal_entity. |
| `order_by` | string | no | Sort field and direction, e.g. "created_at desc" or "updated_at". Sortable fields: id, created_at, updated_at. Default ascending. |
| `limit` | integer | no | Results per page, 1 to 100 (default 50). |
| `cursor` | string | no | Opaque cursor for the next page: the cursor value inside next_link of the previous answer. Omit for the first page. |

### `rippling_list_workers`

List workers (employees and contractors): status, work and personal email, start and end date, title, department, manager, level, teams, location, employment type and country. Filter by status, work_email, user_id, created_at or updated_at. Contains personal data.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /workers/`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `filter` | string | no | OData-style filter on status, work_email, user_id, created_at, updated_at. Operators eq, ne, gt, ge, lt, le, in, and, or; quote strings with single quotes, e.g. status eq 'ACTIVE' or work_email eq 'jane@example.com' or updated_at ge 2026-01-01T00:00:00. |
| `expand` | string | no | Comma-separated related objects to embed instead of only their id (two levels at most, ten fields at most), e.g. "user". Expandable: user, manager, department, teams, level, employment_type, legal_entity, compensation, job_function, custom_fields, business_partners. |
| `order_by` | string | no | Sort field and direction, e.g. "created_at desc" or "updated_at". Sortable fields: id, created_at, updated_at. Default ascending. |
| `limit` | integer | no | Results per page, 1 to 100 (default 50). |
| `cursor` | string | no | Opaque cursor for the next page: the cursor value inside next_link of the previous answer. Omit for the first page. |

### `rippling_get_worker`

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /leave-balances/{id}/`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes | Leave balance id. |
| `expand` | string | no | Comma-separated related objects to embed instead of only their id (two levels at most, ten fields at most), e.g. "worker". Expandable: worker, leave_type. |

### `rippling_list_leave_requests`

List leave requests with worker, requester, reviewer, status (PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED, CANCELED), dates, hours, leave type and comments.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /leave-requests/`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `filter` | string | no | OData-style filter on worker_id, requester_id, reviewer_id, status, leave_policy_id, leave_type_id, start_date, end_date. Operators eq, ne, gt, ge, lt, le, in, and, or; quote strings with single quotes, e.g. status eq 'PENDING' and start_date ge 2026-11-01. |
| `expand` | string | no | Comma-separated related objects to embed instead of only their id (two levels at most, ten fields at most), e.g. "worker". Expandable: worker, requester, reviewer, leave_type. |
| `order_by` | string | no | Sort field and direction, e.g. "created_at desc" or "updated_at". Sortable fields: id, created_at, updated_at. Default ascending. |
| `limit` | integer | no | Results per page, 1 to 100 (default 50). |
| `cursor` | string | no | Opaque cursor for the next page: the cursor value inside next_link of the previous answer. Omit for the first page. |

### `rippling_get_leave_request`

Read one leave request by id: worker, status, dates, hours, leave type, reviewer and comments.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /leave-requests/{id}/`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes | Leave request id. |
| `expand` | string | no | Comma-separated related objects to embed instead of only their id (two levels at most, ten fields at most), e.g. "worker". Expandable: worker, requester, reviewer, leave_type. |

### `rippling_list_time_entries`

List time entries (worked shifts with job shifts, breaks, duration, status DRAFT, APPROVED, PAID or FINALIZED, pay period and tags). Needs Rippling Time and the time-entries.read scope.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /time-entries/`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `filter` | string | no | OData-style filter on worker_id, start_time, pay_period.start_date, updated_at. Operators eq, ne, gt, ge, lt, le, in, and, or; quote strings with single quotes, e.g. worker_id eq '64f0c2...' and start_time ge 2026-10-01T00:00:00. |
| `expand` | string | no | Comma-separated related objects to embed instead of only their id (two levels at most, ten fields at most), e.g. "worker". Expandable: worker, time_card. |
| `order_by` | string | no | Sort field and direction, e.g. "created_at desc" or "updated_at". Sortable fields: id, created_at, updated_at. Default ascending. |
| `limit` | integer | no | Results per page, 1 to 100 (default 50). |
| `cursor` | string | no | Opaque cursor for the next page: the cursor value inside next_link of the previous answer. Omit for the first page. |

### `rippling_get_time_entry`

Read one time entry by id: job shifts, breaks, duration, status, pay period and comments.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /time-entries/{id}/`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes | Time entry id. |
| `expand` | string | no | Comma-separated related objects to embed instead of only their id (two levels at most, ten fields at most), e.g. "worker". Expandable: worker, time_card. |

### `rippling_create_department`

Create a department, optionally under a parent department and with a reference code.

**Access:** write · **Call:** `POST /departments/`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | Department name. |
| `parent_id` | string | no | Parent department id, for a sub-department. |
| `reference_code` | string | no | Reference code, e.g. a cost center. |

### `rippling_update_department`

Change a department's name, parent or reference code. Only the fields sent change.

**Access:** write · **Call:** `PATCH /departments/{id}/`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes | Department id. |
| `name` | string | no | New name. |
| `parent_id` | string | no | New parent department id. |
| `reference_code` | string | no | New reference code. |

### `rippling_create_team`

Create a team, optionally nested under a parent team; assign workers to it in Rippling.

**Access:** write · **Call:** `POST /teams/`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | Team name. |
| `parent_id` | string | no | Parent team id, for a sub-team. |

### `rippling_update_team`

Rename a team or move it under another parent team. Only the fields sent change.

**Access:** write · **Call:** `PATCH /teams/{id}/`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes | Team id. |
| `name` | string | no | New name. |
| `parent_id` | string | no | New parent team id. |

### `rippling_delete_team`

Delete a team; workers lose the team assignment. Cannot be undone; switched off at install.

**Access:** write · **Call:** `DELETE /teams/{id}/`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes | Team id. |

### `rippling_create_work_location`

Create a work location (office) with its name and postal address, for assigning workers.

**Access:** write · **Call:** `POST /work-locations/`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | Work location name. |
| `address` | object | yes | Address: {"street_address":"123 Main St","locality":"Austin","region":"TX","postal_code":"78701","country":"US","type":"WORK"}. country is ISO 3166-1 alpha-2; type is HOME, WORK or OTHER. |

### `rippling_update_work_location`

Rename a work location or change its address. Only the fields sent change.

**Access:** write · **Call:** `PATCH /work-locations/{id}/`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes | Work location id. |
| `name` | string | no | New name. |
| `address` | object | no | Address: {"street_address":"123 Main St","locality":"Austin","region":"TX","postal_code":"78701","country":"US","type":"WORK"}. country is ISO 3166-1 alpha-2; type is HOME, WORK or OTHER. |

### `rippling_create_leave_request`

File a leave request for a worker. With status PENDING it follows the normal approval flow; APPROVED records leave that was already agreed.

**Access:** write · **Call:** `POST /leave-requests/`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `worker_id` | string | yes | Worker id of the person taking leave. |
| `status` | `PENDING` \| `APPROVED` \| `REJECTED` \| `CANCELED` | yes | PENDING asks for approval; APPROVED, REJECTED or CANCELED set the outcome directly. |
| `requester_id` | string | no | Worker id of the person filing the request; defaults to the worker. |
| `start_date` | string | yes | First day, YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `end_date` | string | yes | Last day, YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `start_time` | string | no | Start time on the first day for a partial day, e.g. 13:00. |
| `end_time` | string | no | End time on the last day for a partial day, e.g. 12:00. |
| `start_date_custom_hours` | number | no | Hours off on the first day, for a partial day. |
| `end_date_custom_hours` | number | no | Hours off on the last day, for a partial day. |
| `leave_type_id` | string | no | Leave type id from rippling_list_leave_types. Give this or leave_policy_id. |
| `leave_policy_id` | string | no | Leave policy id. Give this or leave_type_id. |
| `comments` | string | no | Comment shown with the request. |
| `reason_for_leave` | string | no | Reason for the leave. |

### `rippling_update_leave_request`

Approve, reject or cancel a leave request (status), or change its dates and comments. Only the fields sent change.

**Access:** write · **Call:** `PATCH /leave-requests/{id}/`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes | Leave request id. |
| `status` | `PENDING` \| `APPROVED` \| `REJECTED` \| `CANCELED` | no | PENDING asks for approval; APPROVED, REJECTED or CANCELED set the outcome directly. |
| `reviewer_id` | string | no | Worker id of the approver, when approving or rejecting. |
| `reviewed_at` | string | no | When it was reviewed, ISO 8601 date-time. |
| `start_date` | string | no | First day, YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `end_date` | string | no | Last day, YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `start_time` | string | no | Start time on the first day for a partial day, e.g. 13:00. |
| `end_time` | string | no | End time on the last day for a partial day, e.g. 12:00. |
| `start_date_custom_hours` | number | no | Hours off on the first day, for a partial day. |
| `end_date_custom_hours` | number | no | Hours off on the last day, for a partial day. |
| `leave_type_id` | string | no | Leave type id from rippling_list_leave_types. Give this or leave_policy_id. |
| `leave_policy_id` | string | no | Leave policy id. Give this or leave_type_id. |
| `comments` | string | no | Comment shown with the request. |
| `reason_for_leave` | string | no | Reason for the leave. |

### `rippling_create_time_entry`

Record worked time for a worker, as job shifts with start and end times or as a duration on a day.

**Access:** write · **Call:** `POST /time-entries/`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `worker_id` | string | yes | Worker id the time belongs to. |
| `job_shifts` | object[] | no | Worked periods: [{"start_time":"2026-10-29T09:00:00-05:00","end_time":"2026-10-29T17:00:00-05:00","job_codes_id":["..."]}]. For hours only, use duration and start_date instead of start_time and end_time. |
| `breaks` | object[] | no | Breaks: [{"start_time":"...","end_time":"...","break_type_id":"..."}]. |
| `duration` | number | no | Hours worked, when entering a duration instead of start and end times. |
| `start_date` | string | no | Day of a duration entry, YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `comments` | object[] | no | Comments: [{"text":"Covered for a colleague"}]. |
| `tags` | string[] | no | Tags for the entry. |
| `status` | `DRAFT` \| `APPROVED` \| `PAID` \| `FINALIZED` | no | DRAFT (default) or APPROVED; PAID and FINALIZED are set by payroll. |
| `idempotency_key` | string | no | Your own unique key for the entry; a second create with the same key is refused, so retries cannot duplicate it. |

### `rippling_update_time_entry`

Change a time entry: shifts, breaks, duration, comments, tags or status. worker_id is required by the API even when unchanged.

**Access:** write · **Call:** `PATCH /time-entries/{id}/`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes | Time entry id. |
| `worker_id` | string | yes | Worker id the time belongs to. |
| `job_shifts` | object[] | no | Worked periods: [{"start_time":"2026-10-29T09:00:00-05:00","end_time":"2026-10-29T17:00:00-05:00","job_codes_id":["..."]}]. For hours only, use duration and start_date instead of start_time and end_time. |
| `breaks` | object[] | no | Breaks: [{"start_time":"...","end_time":"...","break_type_id":"..."}]. |
| `duration` | number | no | Hours worked, when entering a duration instead of start and end times. |
| `start_date` | string | no | Day of a duration entry, YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `comments` | object[] | no | Comments: [{"text":"Covered for a colleague"}]. |
| `tags` | string[] | no | Tags for the entry. |
| `status` | `DRAFT` \| `APPROVED` \| `PAID` \| `FINALIZED` | no | DRAFT (default) or APPROVED; PAID and FINALIZED are set by payroll. |

### `rippling_delete_time_entry`

Delete a time entry permanently, e.g. a duplicate. Cannot be undone; switched off at install.

**Access:** write · **Call:** `DELETE /time-entries/{id}/`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes | Time entry id. |

### `rippling_create_draft_hires`

Create draft hires that then follow Rippling's review and approval policies before anyone is hired. Each item needs personal_info (name, invite_email), employment_info (employment_type_id, title) and work_location_info.

**Access:** write · **Call:** `POST /draft-hires/`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `draft_hires` | object[] | yes | One to five draft hires, e.g. [{"personal_info":{"name":{"first":"Jane","last":"Doe"},"invite_email":"jane@example.com"},"employment_info":{"employment_type_id":"...","title":"Engineer","start_date":"2026-12-01T00:00:00","department_id":"...","manager_id":"..."},"work_location_info":{"location_id":"..."}}]. Ids come from rippling_list_employment_types, rippling_list_departments, rippling_list_workers and rippling_list_work_locations. |

## Run it yourself

AnythingMCP is open source (AGPL-3.0). [Run it with Docker](../../../README.md#run-it-yourself), open **Connectors → Store**, pick **Rippling** and enter `RIPPLING_API_TOKEN`, then add your MCP server URL to the AI client.
